_note: Hand-maintained from Nebius results releases and consensus aggregators. Update after each earnings 6-K (add the quarter with revenue, ARR and the consensus it was measured against); the dashboard flags when a newer results 6-K exists. USD millions.

quarters.source: Implied by Q2 2026 revenue of $582.3M being +454% YoY
Q3 2025 results release (consistent with FY2025 total of $529.8M in the 20-F)

_balanceNote: USD millions except share counts. cash excludes restricted cash; debt = current + non-current debt (mostly convertible notes, at carrying value). clickhouse/toloka are balance-sheet values of the minority stakes (non-marketable, re-measured on observable transactions). otherInvestments = venture fund + other. Leases excluded.
_sotpNote: USD millions. Sum-of-the-parts defaults, separate from the carrying values above. clickhouse $2,000M is the January 2026 Series D allocation to Nebius's securities before the 22.5% lack-of-marketability discount ($1,517.7 / 0.775). toloka $130M is the May 2025 fair value of the retained stake ($130.6M), not the $86.5M June 2026 book. Avride has no priced round and stays unset. TripleTen is a revenue multiple, not a transaction.

clickhouse.note: January 2026 Series D, $15B headline. The filing marks Nebius's securities at $1,518M after an option-pricing allocation and a 22.5% illiquidity discount. $2,000M is that allocation before the discount. A 25-28% times $15B stake (about $4B) is not the method in the filing, and there has been no round since.

toloka.note: 81% economic interest and 49% of the vote since the May 2025 round led by Bezos Expeditions. Nebius fair-valued the retained stake at $131M then. Books are $87M at June 30, 2026, after losses consumed the common. No later round. Community write-ups use roughly $300-500M.

capitalRaised.detail: June and September 2025 issues, four series due 2029-2032 (accreting to $4.86B at maturity)
12.7M Class A shares at ~$224 in May-June 2026; 12.3M shares still available under the program
Backed by deployed GPUs and an investment-grade customer contract; SOFR + 2.50%, matures Oct 2030
Citi financing facility for data-center growth (drawn as needed)

otherBusinesses.name: Avride
otherBusinesses.note: No priced round, so this stays at zero. Uber holds $175M of SAFEs (fair value $178M at June 30, 2026) that convert at a 20% discount to the next round; the filings state no valuation cap. H1 2026 revenue was $1.9M and adjusted EBITDA was -$74M. Posts citing a $2.7-2.8B post-money, and a Nebius stake near $2.5B, are not in the 20-F or the Uber announcement.

otherBusinesses.name: TripleTen
otherBusinesses.note: FY2025 revenue was $54M. H1 2026 revenue was $22M, down 5%, as U.S. student volumes reset. $150M is about 3-4x a ~$40M run-rate. Older posts used $250-300M, about 5x 2025 sales, before that decline.
